title: Settings
desc: Your account, the workspace and the settings of each app.

states.errorBody: It may be the connection or the database. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell us through Feedback.

account.title: Profile
account.desc: Your details come from the account you sign in with.
account.name: Name
account.note: Change your name and photo in your Google account.
account.demoNote: Demo mode: everyone signs in as the same user. In production you sign in with Google.

ai.title: AI usage
ai.desc: Tokens used by this workspace's AI features this month.
ai.notConfigured: AI is not configured on this server. Set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY or deploy on Vercel with AI Gateway.
ai.quotaNote: When the quota runs out, AI pauses until next month and everything keeps working without it.

keys.title: API keys
keys.desc: For the public API: header Authorization: Bearer zs_…, up to 100 requests per minute per key.
keys.name: Key name
keys.scopesHelp: What the key can do. Write includes read.
keys.createdWarning: Copy it now: you won't see it again.
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key {name}? Anything using it stops working.
keys.emptyBody: Create one to connect scripts, Zapier or your backend to the API.
keys.noteMember: You only see your keys. Owners and admins see the whole workspace's.
keys.noteAdmin: You see the keys of the whole workspace.
keys.error: The key could not be created. Try again.
keys.revokeError: The key could not be revoked.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.desc: We send a POST with signed JSON to your URL when an event happens. Failed deliveries are retried.
webhooks.eventsCount: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
webhooks.signatureHelp: Each delivery carries the header Zerosoft-Signature: t=…,v1=… where v1 is the HMAC-SHA256 of "t.body" with your secret. Compare it before trusting the body.
webhooks.secretWarning: Copy it now: you won't see it again.
webhooks.removeConfirm: Delete the webhook to {url}? We stop sending it events.
webhooks.emptyBody: Add a URL to receive events from bookings, links, contacts, companies, deals, tasks, quotes, forms and robots.
webhooks.adminOnly: Only owners and admins manage webhooks.

errors.private_host: That host points to a private network.
errors.unresolvable_host: That host does not resolve. Check the domain.
errors.invalid_input: Enter a URL and pick at least one event.
errors.generic: The webhook could not be added. Try again.
errors.action: That did not work. Try again.
errors.unknown_link: One of the links in the filter does not exist in this workspace.

linkFilter.title: Only for some links
linkFilter.help: Applies to link events. Leave everything empty to receive events from every link. With several filters, a link has to match all of them.
linkFilter.linksPlaceholder: Slugs separated by commas: promo, launch

propertyFilter.title: Only these properties
propertyFilter.help: For property change events. Use the column name (lifecycle_stage) or custom. plus the field name (custom.plan). Leave it empty to receive every property.

log.title: Deliveries
log.empty: No deliveries yet. Send a test to see one here.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.desc: Keys and tokens used by Flow nodes and Robots steps. Stored encrypted; secrets are never shown.

link.title: Link data
link.desc: Custom domains and the Bitly import live in Link.
link.exportDesc: The CSV has one row per link. The JSON adds every click with referrer, country and device.

admin.feedbackDesc: Messages sent from the app and the site. Only ADMIN_EMAILS see them.
admin.feedbackEmptyBody: What people send from the feedback button in the app or on the site shows up in this list.
admin.kanbanHelp: Drag a card to another column to change its status, or open it and pick the status.
admin.roadmapEmptyBody: Create an item above or move a piece of feedback to the roadmap.
admin.changelogNote: Missing es or pt falls back to the English text.
admin.changelogEmptyBody: Entries published here join the public changelog without a deploy.
admin.actionError: That did not work. Try again.
admin.kanbanMore: {count, plural, one {Show # more column} other {Show # more columns}}
